releases.name: v1.1.0 Achievements+ patch
releases.body:
Debug:
- Typo fixes
- More coverage of translatable text
- Minor visual tweaks (Rotated one item 45° for better Feng Shui)
- Nerfed the player's strength (You should no longer be able to barbarically shove the artifact instead of a lantern in the reelhouse spot)
- Buttons are now pressed and not rotated
- The unpowered structure now makes an appropriate amount of unpowered noises

New:
- 14 exciting achievements! Enable the Achievement+ mod and have fun earning them all.
- French translation curtesy of cOa Rex
- Chinese translation curtesy of SanBaiMing. Many thanks to both of them!

releases.name: v1.0.5 QoL Patch
releases.body:
Debug:
- Various typo fixes (including Feldspar misgendering)
- Campfire now campfiring as intended

New:
- Added prompts for the doors
- A small area is now walkable
- Torches fire now made more colorful
- Timeloop paused during ending
- Now compatible with Achievement+ (Barebone achievements for now, next patch should add more)
- Readme updated so that Signal Jammers team members are named, rather than just in the credits
- Extracted missing translatable lines into the translation file

releases.name: v1.0.4 Performance patch
releases.body:
Debug: 
- Scout recall bug now fixed
- Minor typo fixes

New: 
- Small rework of the quantum puzzle, to allow for a solution players thought about but not us devs
- Performance should be much better now that buildings meshes have been batched

releases.name: v1.0.3 More Polishing
releases.body:
Debug:
- Music has been reduced in some areas to a more pleasant volume.
- Took Ernesto to anger management, he now screams a reasonable amount.
- Brought the floating geyser back to the ground.
- Removed the shuttle after it has been used.
- Added a collider to an object without one.

New:
- Reduced the range of the star lighting, so that it does not interfere with other jam5 mods if those systems are near.
- Turned the power off completely where there shouldn't be power, and added some directions in that place.
- Fire made more fiery.

releases.name: v1.0.2 Polishing
releases.body:
Debug:
- Depressurization no longer burst your eardrums
- Tweaked position of a couple triggers, should work better

New:
- Ending now says the mod name
- Made a puzzle react more clearly when the player does the correct thing
- Added more decoration portraits

releases.name: v1.0.1 Hotfix
releases.body:
- make our star's effects fit within the jam limits
- made both regular and persistent conditions for meeting a certain someone, for other modders to use it.
- a certain shiplog photo is now up to date.
- make a sound a bit more audible in the ending
- update readme to include licenses
- update licenses.txt

releases.name: Initial Release
releases.body: initial release for cosmic curators, our outer wilds mod jam 5 submission.
